Bar Council of India Regulates Social Media Use by Lawyers and Interns

The Bar Council of India (BCI) has issued a circular to regulate the social media activities of lawyers and law interns. The directive aims to curb the sensationalization of courtroom proceedings and enforce ethical standards online. It specifies guidelines on what can and cannot be posted, including restrictions on promotional content and 'day in chamber' posts.
